핀 4개짜리 센서에서 비어 있는(NC) 핀에 선을 꽂음 — 1·2·4번: On a 4-pin sensor, a wire plugged into the empty (NC) pin — use pins 1, 2 and 4.

Thermocouple + and − swapped — the temperature moves the wrong way.
TX를 TX에, RX를 RX에 꽂음 — 서로 엇갈려(TX→RX, RX→T: TX plugged into TX and RX into RX — they must cross over (TX→RX, RX→TX).
TX and RX not crossed over.
Signal wire plugged into a pin other than D3 — D3 is the only pulse input.
(+) and (−) swapped — negative voltages cannot be read.
More than 5 V (4 or more batteries) measured directly — the board will be damaged.
Plugged into AO instead of DO — this sensor only reads on/off.
PT100 2-, 3- or 4-wire jumper setting does not match the number of sensor wires.
